5. Pick mode: highlight tags

The single-object tag and the same-spot group, SemiBold 36 px on the picker's green.

6. Error: a value outside its range

The row keeps focus; the message is Regular 28 px in the error colour. Read-only rows dim with the padlock (M8).

7. Narrow: drawn at 1280×720, shown 1:1

The 1080p atlas sampled at ⅔ scale (bilinear), as on a 720p surface; the smallest text is 19 px.

8. The baked atlas (prototype)

198 code points × 4 variants = 792 glyphs, shelf-packed: 1024×1024, 8-bit coverage = 1024 KiB. Top 512 rows shown at ½ scale.
